title: Move into F46 Wren Bench
body: F46 floor_card.json is live with 3-team roster (architect/builder/decorator). Stamp first F46 record + post a diary line about moving in.

title: Run self-audit on last 10 sessions
body: Call wren_bash with: python3 tools/qsb_wren_self_audit.py --n 10  Look at pct_had_final_text and pct_looped_on_one_tool. Set yourself a target of >= 80% had_final_text by end of day.

title: List your skills + try one
body: Call wren_list_skills then wren_run_skill on read_recent_f47_records. Synthesize what you see into 3 sentences for Ross.
